title: 3 methods to fight your body dysmorphia
summary: Video on three ways to fight muscle dysmorphia (bigorexia); the captions are junk, so only the description is usable. He says dysmorphia damages mental health and training progress if left untreated, and that he has dealt with bigorexia for years.
claims: Untreated body dysmorphia will damage your mental health and, since mind and body are linked, your ability to train and progress, while making daily life miserable
He has been dealing with bigorexia for years
